title: See variable capture
description: This deliberately wrong reduction shows why a free replacement variable needs protection from an inner binder.

steps.description: The application passes the free variable y to a function whose body contains an inner λy.
This naive beta step tries to substitute y for x inside λy.x without changing the inner binder.

steps.question: What happens to the replacement y after this naive substitution?
steps.answer: The inner λy captures it, changing a free y into a bound variable.

steps.description: The result λy.y is the identity function. The page identifies this result as wrong because it changes the expression's meaning.
